data.title: MAMA Residences
data.about:
Mama Residences Dubai isn't just a hotel; it's a lifestyle renaissance by Ennismore, a leader in lifestyle hospitality. It's a place to call home within the Mama brand. Designed by Franklin Azzi Architecture and brought to life by French designer Thierry Gaugain, this stunning steel, concrete, and glass tower redefines Dubai's architectural landscape. Gaugain, known as one of the vanguards of contemporary French design, has infused this project with a vision centered around "life, luxury, and light," ushering in a new era of trendsetting energy in Business Bay.

Situated just moments away from the iconic Burj Khalifa, Mama Residences offers more than just a place to stay; it's a lifestyle experience. These eclectic residential apartments, including studios and 1-2 bedroom Residences, represent a Paris-born design concept elevated to new heights in the heart of Dubai's skyline. With luxurious and avant-garde design elements, these homes are a fusion of modernism's bold aesthetics and the vibrant styling characteristic of the world's most forward-thinking designers. Within a building that's a work of art itself, Mama Residences transforms the city's skyline with its bold and visionary architecture.

characteristics_module.title: Where Bold Design Meets Boutique Living – Dive Into the Mama Lifestyle.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Fully furnished and serviced residences, including studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments
  • Designed by acclaimed Paris-based Franklin Azzi Architecture and French designer Thierry Gaugain
  • Private residential entrance, lobby, and lifts for exclusive access and privacy
  • Signature lifestyle by the Mama Shelter brand, part of the Accor Group
  • Four outdoor swimming pools, including a children’s pool, water lounge, and swim-up bar
  • Pool deck with cabanas, DJ tower, multiple poolside bars, and vibrant entertainment zones
  • State-of-the-art gymnasium, pamper rooms, and treatment facilities
  • Outdoor amphitheater with lounge and entertainment areas
  • Business amenities include meeting rooms and a fully equipped business center
  • Multiple signature F&B venues plus an exclusive, invitation-only hidden bar
  • Prime location in Business Bay, minutes from Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and Dubai Metro
  • A la carte hotel-style services, including housekeeping and concierge
  • Ready-to-move-in with a 50/50 payment plan

location_tile.title: Find MAMA in Business Bay
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
As a resident in Business Bay, you will always be in the middle of the activity, right next to the world-famous Burj Khalifa. Conveniently located near the vibrant energy of Downtown Dubai, this community provides everything you could want in a modern residential district: a plethora of five-star hotels, world-class restaurants run by Michelin-starred chefs, a wide array of shops and boutiques, and, of course, nonstop entertainment.

With its trendy community ambiance and proximity to the Dubai Mall, The Museum of the Future, and Dubai Opera, Business Bay is the perfect spot for couples and professionals looking for a place to call home. Mama ensures that you can reach any place effortlessly from the center of the city, with seamless access to the Business Bay Metro station and Sheikh Zayed Road. The airport can be reached in about 25 minutes.
